==English==

===Pronunciation===
* {{IPA|en|/ˈtɛlɪˌfəʊn ˌkɔːl/|/ˈtɛləˌfəʊn ˌkɔːl/|a=RP}}
** {{audio|en|LL-Q1860 (eng)-Vealhurl-telephone call.wav|a=Southern England}}
* {{IPA|en|/ˈtɛləˌfoʊn ˌkɔl/|a=GA|/ˈtɛləˌfoʊn ˌkɑl/|a2=cot-caught}}
** {{audio|en|LL-Q1860 (eng)-Flame, not lame-telephone call.wav|a=US}}

===Noun===
{{en-noun}}

# {{senseid|en|connection}} A [[connection]] established over a telephone [[network]] between two [[party|parties]].
#: {{coi|en|make a '''telephone call''';   take a '''telephone call'''}}
#: {{rfquote-sense|en}}
# {{senseid|en|conversation}} The [[conversation]] held by the two parties on this connection.
#: {{rfquote-sense|en}}
# {{lb|en|law|colloquial}} A [[quick]], [[informal]] [[consultation]] or [[conversation]] with a [[lawyer]], usually by a [[party]] in [[distress]] or that is about to be [[place]]d under [[arrest]].

====Usage notes====
* The third sense is usually constructed as ''I'd like to make a telephone call'' or ''I'd like a telephone call.''
